description: Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources - Fisheries Development and Management Plan of the Koggala Lagoon
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of a Fisheries Development and Management Plan for the Koggala Lagoon under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No. 2 of 1996. It contains regulatory frameworks, management principles, implementation procedures, and legal notifications related to fisheries management. While it mentions the Minister of Fisheries in the signature block, this is incidental to the main content which focuses on establishing legal/regulatory frameworks for lagoon management rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio assignments. The content fits the Legal/Regulatory category as it involves statutory instruments, regulatory compliance requirements, and implementation of legislation.
